-- Schema and reporting queries for a small bookshop.
-- Fixture for the token estimator tests: PostgreSQL-flavoured SQL with
-- DDL, constraints, a view, window functions and a CTE.

CREATE TABLE customers (
    id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    email       TEXT        NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    full_name   TEXT        NOT NULL,
    country     CHAR(2)     NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NL',
    created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE books (
    isbn        CHAR(13)       PRIMARY KEY,
    title       TEXT           NOT NULL,
    author      TEXT           NOT NULL,
    price_cents INTEGER        NOT NULL CHECK (price_cents >= 0),
    stock       INTEGER        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    published   DATE
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
    id           BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id  BIGINT      NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    status       TEXT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                 CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
    ordered_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE order_items (
    order_id    BIGINT   NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    isbn        CHAR(13) NOT NULL REFERENCES books (isbn),
    quantity    INTEGER  NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    unit_cents  INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (order_id, isbn)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders (customer_id, ordered_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_books_author    ON books (lower(author));

-- One row per order with its total.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW order_totals AS
SELECT o.id            AS order_id,
       o.customer_id,
       o.status,
       o.ordered_at,
       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_cents) AS total_cents,
       COUNT(*)                       AS line_count
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id, o.customer_id, o.status, o.ordered_at;

-- Monthly revenue with a running total and month-over-month change.
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', ordered_at)::date AS month,
           SUM(total_cents) / 100.0              AS revenue
    FROM order_totals
    WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue, 2)                                          AS revenue,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2)               AS running_total,
       ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))
             / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 1)  AS change_pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

-- Top five customers of the last 90 days.
SELECT c.full_name,
       c.email,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.order_id)         AS orders,
       SUM(t.total_cents) / 100.0         AS spent
FROM customers c
JOIN order_totals t ON t.customer_id = c.id
WHERE t.ordered_at >= now() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND t.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.full_name, c.email
HAVING SUM(t.total_cents) > 5000
ORDER BY spent DESC
LIMIT 5;

-- Books that sold out but still have open orders.
SELECT b.isbn, b.title, SUM(i.quantity) AS waiting
FROM books b
JOIN order_items i ON i.isbn = b.isbn
JOIN orders o      ON o.id = i.order_id AND o.status = 'pending'
WHERE b.stock = 0
GROUP BY b.isbn, b.title
ORDER BY waiting DESC, b.title;

-- Restock in one statement and report what changed.
UPDATE books
SET stock = stock + 20
WHERE isbn IN ('9780000000017', '9780000000024')
RETURNING isbn, title, stock;

BEGIN;
INSERT INTO customers (email, full_name, country)
VALUES ('ana@example.com', 'Ana Ferreira', 'PT')
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name;
COMMIT;
